_about: Copy to brand/brand.json and fill every field. Claude fills this from the brand interview in deploy/DEPLOY.md, step 1.
name: First name or brand name
topics: the 3 to 6 subjects the brand posts about, written as one phrase, e.g. 'fitness, nutrition, discipline and running a gym'
topics_short: same subjects as a short comma list
research_topics: the subjects to watch on X, as one phrase
author_story: One or two sentences of TRUE background the writer may lean on. Example: 'The author is a physio who opened her own clinic and shares what she learns in public.'
author_short: the same story as a clause starting 'whose author ...'
voice: Tone in 2 to 4 short sentences, ending with a full stop. Example: 'warm, practical, a little funny. Short sentences. No jargon.'
first_person_rule: what the writer may say in first person, e.g. 'first person is only for the fact that the author runs a clinic'
post_rules: Topic-specific hard rules as full sentences. Include compliance rules for regulated topics (finance, health, legal) and any phrases the owner never wants.
x_rules: the same rules, short, separated by semicolons, for X posts
proof_note: named_assets = named products, tools or brands
topic_groups: 10 to 15 specific sub-topics the brain should track
